newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Lisnave has new contracts.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Lisnave has new contracts.

text.p: Struggling Portuguese ship repairer Lisnave-Estaleiros Navais de Lisboa has obtained two contracts worth 17 billion escudos to be carried out this year, a major shareholder Jose Manuel de Mello said.

One of the contracts, worth $61.6 million (about 11 billion escudos), is to convert "Peregrine VI", a gas transport vessel with a capacity of 130,000 tonnes, into a ship capable of working on oil terminals.
The second contract, worth $32 million (six billion escudos), is for work on a ship belonging to Brazilian oil company Petrobras.
Mello was speaking to reporters yesterday after signing an agreement with Economy Minister Augusto Mateus for the restructuring of Lisnave.
